$comment: Single source of truth for the army's units. tools/sync-army.js generates agent frontmatter, the order-of-battle tables and the map from this file; CI fails if they drift. 'eco' is the cheapest profile (/army:mode eco): Sonnet only where a wrong answer is expensive, Haiku elsewhere. Agent frontmatter uses the LEAN model, so a unit dispatched without an explicit model never runs on Opus by accident. 'tools: null' means the unit inherits every tool (engineering-style units that must run and change code).
